single_seed.why: Pre-dates llm-distillery#158 by seven months (created 2026-01-23) and its seed cannot be established without guessing: this config declares classifier_type MLPClassifier while the trainer in the tree (training/train.py) builds a transformers Trainer at seed=42, so the shipped head did not come from that path. Recorded as UNRECORDED rather than assumed to be 42.
